extension.summary: FIA WEC+ – WEC, ELMS and Michelin Le Mans Cup in Kodi
extension.description: Enjoy endurance racing with FIA WEC+. The add-on provides access to races, qualifying, practice sessions, replays and other available WEC, ELMS and MLMC content. Protected content requires a valid FIA WEC+ account and the appropriate subscription.
extension.news:
[1.7.5] - Compact three-line information for regular WEC/ELMS/MLMC videos - Unified three-line presentation for WEC and ELMS onboard videos - Removed duplicate class information from onboard entries - WEC onboard videos now correctly use Hypercar/LMGT3 from the selected folder - Added Spanish ES language detection - Cleaned WEC archive titles containing embedded session names - Improved ELMS onboard detection for separate Staylive event channels - Spa-Francorchamps onboards use verified channel 7513 - Silverstone onboards use verified channel 7614 - Added a general fallback for future elms-<event>-onboards channels - Upcoming Livestreams presentation remains unchanged
[1.7] - Added official FIA WEC+ 2026 race posters and Hero/Cover backgrounds - Improved ELMS/MLMC Upcoming Livestreams with chronological sorting and stream-specific thumbnails - Added LIVE/TODAY/TOMORROW labels and improved local time handling - Unified account/cookie status display - Kodi provider name changed to MiSeRy
